text:
Drowsy is the afternoon. Beside the narrow fold

the cattle nap. The skittish cow

moos calmly, while the rock blows

the bittersweet nose of the good shy calf...


Seen between brambles is the heated crag

behind which the amate gives its local note.

A westering sun, undecided, designs

on the mother-of-pearl of the sky its bloodied disk.


Along the long dusty solitary road

the voice of the bell tower spreads at length,

and the murmur of the wood and the bull's rebellowing.


And to the native lap of the wild huts

the insinuating girls return from the fountain

shelling in the air their golden cantilenas.

translation.title: The Return
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the countryside's late-afternoon return as sound, cattle, and song.
